intro.text: The Red Cranium Nano Cloak is a Clan & Meta-Physicist only item but you can remove some of these requirements. Doing so however will also remove or lower some of the modifiers: Nano Init. and MaxNanoEnergy. The quality of the Field Quantum Physics All-Purpose Tool and Hacker Tool must be at least 40% of QL of the cloak.

steps.skills: FQP tool needs to be at least 40% the ql of Tank Armor. You'll need 5x Field Quantum Physics skill to hack it.
